benchmark.timingMethod: Bespoke same-source operation benchmark; not Test262 coverage. proc_pid_rusage V0 user/system CPU counters converted through mach_timebase_info, sampled every 1 ms between initial stop and final exit. CPU is a lower bound; the final unobserved wall interval bounds missing CPU. Monotonic inferior-wall includes debugger resume/exit handling and excludes launch.
benchmark.limitations: Shared-host scheduling varies. Each sampled CPU value is a lower bound with a separately recorded final unobserved wall interval. No whole-suite speedup is inferred from this operation benchmark.

Test262.equivalence: Both original 300000 ms variant budgets time out after initial stop before and after. These equal classifications do not establish matching completed JIT results. The copy-only change alone does not make this eval-heavy selection practical.
Test262.compileOnlyWholeSuiteProjection: No generated-code benchmark rate is applied to the Node-hosted compilation phase; historical fixed-overhead analysis remains separate.
